scope: Explicit tracked allowlist for the UAS handoff, including original public assignment PDF, synthetic fixtures, video, docs and reproducibility source/config. No env values are printed.
limitations: Configured exact values and bare private keys plus private-key PEM/remote authenticated PostgreSQL URL patterns; not a claim to detect every unknown secret.
Binary evidence is scanned as raw bytes; private runtime stores, traces, cookies and workflow state are excluded by selection, not exported.
